message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout that left us without power for a few hours. After grabbing my trusty flashlight and ensuring my phone was charged, I found myself sitting on the floor with my kids, playing a good old-fashioned board game instead of scrolling through screens. It was such a sweet reminder of how much fun we can have with just a little imagination and a sprinkle of low-tech magic! How do you keep the fun going during a power outage?
